notes: These are starting hypotheses, not measured optimal settings or allocation guarantees.
The expert cache is a subset of the total owned budget, not additional memory.
A dense run does not reserve an unused expert cache.
Context includes prompt and generated tokens. Reject overflow; do not silently truncate.
Refuse streaming if the smallest valid live expert working set exceeds the admitted cache.
Backend allocations must be measured and covered before describing the total as a hard cap.
A measured 1,024-slot cache on the 35B artifact reduced reads 23.5% but increased read time and lowered decode; the implementation default is 64 slots with demand reads.
